C34 NONBLOCKING NOTE — PR277 / deployed85c38c1c19: missing once-per-daemon restore-duration marker (PERF277-OBS1).

restore_receiver_edges has no success start/end/duration log or spine event. Existing evidence proves its initialization finished before the first native.receiver.lapsed event, but cannot separate restore time from boot or the60s receiver grace. Current daemon97798: ready02:38:04.817031Z; first lapse log02:39:04.750687Z, corroborated by spine seq4671483 at1795142344750ms. Process birth is02:38:04Z to one-second resolution. State this as within boot plus grace, no marker—not a59.934s/60.751s measured restore, and not the prior warm SQLite probe time.

Small observability follow-up only, not a normal-use performance blocker or request to reopen277: report restore start/completion and elapsed time once per daemon (optionally seats/probe counts/outcome), with no per-seat log, new poll or process launch. Then a later bounce can price the real SQLx/lock/transaction path. No source edits, restart or build made here.
